title: ProviderCredentialCreate
description: Body of POST /provider-credentials. Permission: providers.create. An organisation holds at most one credential per provider: if it already has one for this provider (enabled or not) the call is a 422 validation_failed on `provider` — rotate that credential's key with PATCH instead. Unknown keys are a 422.

provider.description: Upstream provider slug. Can only be set at create; changing it means a new credential. Create-only: on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field. Changing it means replacing the resource.

key.description: The provider API key. Write-only: never returned, logged or audited; only fingerprint is shown. Verified against the provider before it is stored — a key the provider rejects is a 422 validation_failed on `key` with the verification message.

enabled.description: Absent = true on create, unchanged on update or replace. Boolean only: null is a 422.

id.description: Response field (read-only). Absent or null on create; on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field.

fingerprint.description: Response field (read-only). Absent or null on create; on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field.

created_at.description: Response field (read-only). Absent or null on create; on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field.

updated_at.description: Response field (read-only). Absent or null on create; on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field.
